name: pomodoro
title: Pomodoro
description: Focus and break timer with YouTube live music or offline ambient sounds.
author: black

commands.name: pomodoro
commands.title: Pomodoro
commands.subtitle: Focus and break timer
commands.description: Focus and break timer with YouTube live music or offline ambient sounds

commands.name: advance
commands.title: Advance Session
commands.description: Internal: end the current focus or break when its time is up

preferences.name: focusMinutes
preferences.title: Focus Minutes
preferences.description: Length of a focus session, 1 to 600 minutes.

preferences.name: breakMinutes
preferences.title: Break Minutes
preferences.description: Length of a break, 1 to 120 minutes.

preferences.name: autoContinue
preferences.title: Auto Continue
preferences.label: Start the next focus when a break ends
preferences.description: Without this a break ends paused and the next focus starts when you say so.

preferences.name: musicOnBreak
preferences.title: Music on Break
preferences.label: Keep the music playing during breaks
preferences.description: Off, the music stops when a focus ends and starts again with the next one.

preferences.name: chime
preferences.title: Chime
preferences.label: Play a chime when a phase ends
preferences.description: The chime sounds next to the notification at the end of every focus and break.

preferences.name: customChannel
preferences.title: Custom Channel
preferences.description: An extra YouTube link to offer as a music source. Leave empty to skip it.
